title: What came between Kingdom of Hawaiʻi and Republic of Hawaii?
question: What came between Kingdom of Hawaiʻi and Republic of Hawaii?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Kingdom of Hawaiʻi (1795) to Republic of Hawaii (1894): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
